PigeonLetterCapacity.definition: The number of letters a carrier pigeon can carry at a time

PigeonTreatCost.definition: The number of treats required for a carrier pigeon's service

OwlLetterCapacity.definition: The number of letters an owl can carry at a time

OwlTreatCost.definition: The number of treats required for an owl's service

MaxOwlProportion.definition: The maximum proportion of birds that can be owls

TotalTreats.definition: The total number of treats available

MinPigeons.definition: The minimum number of carrier pigeons that must be used
